title: Open Schematify for Design and Planning
trigger: User wants to plan the architecture or design for the project

steps.action: Click the + in the switcher bar and select Schematify from the apps list
Schematify can also be opened from the Apps menu in the title bar
Schematify opens in a pane, showing design canvases, stack schematics, and planning tools

outcome: Schematify opens in a pane, showing the technical and product design for the project
